messages:
lina: starting canary deploy for embed-service v2.14 -> v2.15. change window open 30m, initial roll 10% -> 50% if green.

deploy-bot: canary started -> embed-service:v2.15 at 10% traffic. monitors: slo/embeddings_p95, error/5xx_rate, route:/v1/embeds 4xx/5xx. watchlist applied.

jess: heads-up — v2.15 includes a header-validation change: requests without `x-client-id` will now return 400. intended for tightening, but older clients might fail.

omar: @jess seeing a small but sharp 4xx uptick. tenant=acme-corp shows 4xx -> 2.1% over 5m (baseline ~0.1%). p95 latency normal.

kevin: quick query from dashboard:

```

sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/embeds",status=~"4.."}[1m])) by (tenant)

```

keeps pointing to acme-corp spike. overall 5xx steady.

jess: that matches — my change made `x-client-id` required. we can make it optional (+compat) or pin acme to v2.14 while we patch.

lina: decision: pause rollout at 10%. apply route-level pin for acme -> v2.14 and halt further traffic shifts. @deploy-bot do the pin and pause.

deploy-bot: ack. pin applied: tenant=acme-corp -> embed-service:v2.14. canary traffic paused at 10%. alerting: pinned version audit event emitted.

omar: confirmed routing table shows acme -> v2.14. 4xx for acme dropped back to baseline within two minutes. monitoring: will watch 10m window.

jess: I'll open a quick compatibility patch to accept missing `x-client-id` (fallback path) and add a clear deprecation note to the release notes. will tag @lina for review.

kevin: :thumbsup: i'll keep eyes on slo dashboards and the rentention of tails. i'll also add a short ops note to changelog: "compatibility follow-up for v2.15 header validation" (link: https://redwood.internal/changelog/PR-XXXX).

sre-alerts-bot: routed alert suppressed for tenant=acme-corp due to pin. suppression expires when canary resumes.

lina: thanks. extending change window +1h to give team time to patch and re-run canary. we'll reconvene before resuming traffic shift. good catch everyone :heart:
thread_summary: Canary paused at 10% after header-validation change in v2.15 caused tenant-specific 4xx spike; applied route-level pin for acme->v2.14, will patch and extend change window.
